predicted_motion.note: External Luhman 2014 prediction plus builtin Earth ephemeris; not fitted to these two epochs.

motion.snr_note: Aperture statistic conditional on fitted position; best individual comparison uses the coadd mask. Not a blind detection significance or total flux measurement.
motion.uncertainty_note: Conditional centroid noise + calibration covariance + conservative second-moment heldout term; not a discovery probability or full systematic-error budget.

calibration_bootstrap.note: Paired resampling of training sources; one correlated Gaia 5-parameter draw per source shared across all epochs. Positive covariance envelope with the formal independent-exposure estimate. Conditional on measured centroids and ePSF.

injection_diagnostics.note: Fixed real-background grid, shared input images and matched injection/fit ePSF. Flux profile conditional on WISE 0855 fits; no added shot noise. Calibration kept fixed. These correlated small-sample diagnostics are not completeness, false-positive rate, or independent coverage calibration.
